section.title: Formatting a price
section.scenario: A shop shows prices on its product pages.
section.question: Prices are shown in one currency today. Which piece fits better?
section.piece_a:
class Price
  def initialize(cents)
    @cents = cents
  end

  def to_s
    format("$%.2f", @cents / 100.0)
  end
end
section.piece_b:
module PriceFormatter
  def self.call(cents)
    format("$%.2f", cents / 100.0)
  end
end
